False positive: process_update holds the store mutex guard continuously from lock() to drop(guard). No concurrent writer can interleave. Single-writer architecture (one kithd per user) means there is no actual race.

False positive by design: marking a message as read locally is a local state change that succeeds regardless of contact block status. Receipt delivery is correctly skipped for blocked contacts. The two operations are intentionally independent.

Acceptable for Phase 1: single-user, SQLite ops are fast in-process. Lock is dropped before return. Not a blocker.
Acceptable for Phase 1: N+1 contact lookups on primary key, each O(log n). At most 50 entries per tick. Pre-existing pattern throughout outbox_tick.

Assessed: key_der Vec<u8> is moved (not cloned) into PrivateKeyDer — no intermediate copy to zeroize. The limitation is in rustls 0.23 which does not implement Zeroize on PrivateKeyDer.
